name: kappa-code
displayName: Kilo Code: AI Coding Agent, Copilot, and Autocomplete
description: Open Source AI coding agent that generates code from natural language, automates tasks, and runs terminal commands. Features inline autocomplete, browser automation, automated refactoring, and custom modes for planning, coding, and debugging. Supports 500+ AI models including Claude (Anthropic), Gemini, Grok, GPT, Codex and GLM.

kappa-code.new.language.description: Override the UI language for Kilo Code (e.g. en, de, ja). Empty means use VS Code's display language.

kappa-code.new.languageCommitMessage.description: Language used for AI-generated commit messages. Choose 'sync' to follow the Kilo Code UI language, or select a specific language.

kappa-code.new.model.providerID.description: Default model provider ID for new sessions

kappa-code.new.model.modelID.description: Default model ID for new sessions

kappa-code.new.autocomplete.provider.description: Provider to use for inline autocomplete suggestions. If unset, Kilo Gateway is used.

kappa-code.new.agentManager.autoBranchNa.description: Automatically name new Agent Manager branches when the conversation describes a clear task. Explicitly named and published branches are never renamed.

kappa-code.new.agentManager.branchPrefix.description: Prefix for automatically named Agent Manager branches, for example 'marius/' or 'feature/'. Explicit branch names are unchanged.

kappa-code.new.agentManager.worktreePool.description: Pre-warm a ready worktree in the background so new Agent Manager sessions start faster. Uses extra disk space equal to one checkout per open project. Turn off to create worktrees only on demand.

kappa-code.new.experimental.browserAutom.description: Enable the experimental Integrated Browser panel and browser_open tool in Agent Manager.

kappa-code.new.experimental.conversation.description: Keep the prompt input history (ArrowUp/ArrowDown recall) separate for each conversation instead of sharing one history across all conversations.

kappa-code.new.experimental.claudeMigrat.description: Experimental one-time import of supported global Claude Code instructions, simple skills, and disabled MCP definitions into Kilo. The original Claude files are never changed.

enumDescriptions: Open or focus the VS Code integrated terminal.
Open or focus an embedded terminal in the Agent Manager side panel.
kappa-code.new.agentManager.terminalButt.description: Default destination for the Agent Manager terminal button and Focus Terminal keyboard shortcut. The terminal button's dropdown remembers its own choice per Agent Manager panel; this setting only applies to panels that never picked one.

kappa-code.new.indexing.showButtonWhenDi.description: Show the codebase indexing button below the prompt while indexing is disabled.

kappa-code.new.claudeCodeCompat.description: Load CLAUDE.md instructions and skills from your Claude Code configuration directory into Kilo sessions. Enable this if you want Kilo to use your Claude Code instructions and skills.

kappa-code.new.extraCaCerts.description: Absolute path to a PEM file containing extra CA certificates to trust when the Kilo backend makes HTTPS requests (sets NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS on the CLI process). Use this if you're behind a corporate proxy that performs SSL inspection. Leave empty to rely on the OS trust store.

kappa-code.new.autoApprove.enabled.description: Start Kilo Code with the main auto-approve toggle enabled. When enabled, permission prompts are approved automatically. Sandbox escalation prompts are always excluded.

kappa-code.new.maxCost.description: Show a non-blocking alert when a session exceeds this USD amount. Use whole dollars; set to 0 to disable.

kappa-code.new.fontSize.description: Font size in pixels for the Kilo Code webview UI.

kappa-code.new.browserAutomation.enabled.description: Enable browser automation powered by Playwright. When enabled, the AI agent can interact with web pages in a visible Chrome window.

kappa-code.new.browserAutomation.useSyst.description: Use your system's installed Chrome browser instead of downloading a separate Chromium instance.

kappa-code.new.browserAutomation.headles.description: Run browser automation in headless mode (no visible window). When disabled, you can watch the agent interact with the browser.

kappa-code.new.agentManager.browser.useS.description: Use system-installed Google Chrome for the Integrated Browser. Disable only when a compatible Playwright Chromium browser is already installed.

enumDescriptions: Open web links in your default browser.
Open web links in a browser tab from the sidebar, or in the browser panel from Agent Manager.
kappa-code.new.agentManager.browser.open.description: Choose where web links open from Kilo chats. Requires the experimental Integrated Browser.

kappa-code.new.attention.enabled.description: Play sounds when sessions complete, error, or need input

kappa-code.new.attention.notifications.description: Show VS Code notifications when Kilo completes a task or needs input. Notifications are suppressed while a Kilo panel is active.

kappa-code.new.attention.OSNotifications.description: Show native OS notification alerts when Kilo completes a task or needs input while VS Code is not active.

kappa-code.new.attention.sound.description: Use different sounds for completion, input, and errors, or choose one sound for every event

kappa-code.new.showTaskTimeline.description: Show the task timeline graph in the chat header

kappa-code.new.showShortcutHints.description: Show the keyboard shortcut that fits what you do now in the empty prompt, for example how to add selected code or return to the prompt.

kappa-code.new.showTokenThroughput.description: Show tokens-per-second (prompt-processing / text-generation) badges on assistant messages and the task header

kappa-code.new.showAutoApprovalReason.description: Show a line on tool calls explaining why they were auto-approved (matched rule, agent default, YOLO mode, etc.)

kappa-code.new.chat.shiftTabCyclesVarian.description: Cycle through reasoning effort variants with Shift+Tab in prompt inputs. Disable to keep Shift+Tab for keyboard focus navigation.

kappa-code.new.agentManager.pushFixes.description: Agent Manager: when you send pull request CI failures or review comments to the agent, or update a worktree from its base, ask the agent to commit and push so the pull request updates. Permission prompts still apply. Disable to keep commits manual.

Human in the Loop: review agent actions as they happen
High autonomy: let Kilo take most actions with fewer interruptions
Onboarding was skipped without changing work style settings
kappa-code.new.agentWorkStyle.description: Preferred agent work style. Set to Unset to show the onboarding flow again.

kappa-code.new.diff.renderMarkdown.description: Render Markdown files in Kilo diff viewers by default. Toggle this from a Markdown file header in the diff viewer.

kappa-code.new.diff.style.description: Remembered unified/split choice for Kilo diff viewers. Set automatically the first time you toggle the style in a diff viewer.
